name: Sylvester Kaczmarek
bio: Safe, secure AI and autonomy for critical systems, space, and robotics.

personal_repos.name: autonomyfit
personal_repos.description: Command-line tool that detects local edge-AI hardware and ranks models against memory, latency, throughput, power, and runtime constraints.

personal_repos.name: phisat2-trustworthy-onboard-ai
personal_repos.description: Trustworthy onboard satellite AI in PyTorch→ONNX→INT8 with calibration, telemetry, and a PhiSat-2 EO tile-filter demo.

personal_repos.name: satcom-fec-trust-lab
personal_repos.description: Pocket satcom IQ acquisition and replay lab with scalar, Arm NEON and SME2 kernels, correctness tests, benchmarks and trust diagnostics.

personal_repos.name: lunar-astrodynamics-simulation
personal_repos.description: Lunar orbit propagation and preliminary mission analysis with high-fidelity gravity, perturbations, terrain, stability, targeting and coverage.

personal_repos.name: nvidia-cudaq-quantum-guard
personal_repos.description: Policy-controlled NVIDIA CUDA-Q execution with resource preflight, target guardrails, diagnostics, backend comparison, and tamper-evident audit trails.

personal_repos.name: guardian-agent-runtime
personal_repos.description: Reference monitor and adversarial benchmark for enforcing capabilities, runtime safety constraints, and verifiable evidence around agentic systems.

personal_repos.name: agent-boundary-check
personal_repos.description: Verify what AI coding agents can actually read, write, execute and reach using synthetic canaries.

personal_repos.name: rosbag-doctor

personal_repos.name: awesome-space-autonomy
personal_repos.description: Curated research, flight demonstrations, software, tools, and guidance for autonomous spacecraft and space robots.

personal_repos.name: xlstm-telemetry-assurance
personal_repos.description: Controlled PyTorch experiments testing xLSTM-style streaming forecasting and runtime assurance under telemetry faults, distribution shift and guarded adaptation.

personal_repos.name: worldstate-check
personal_repos.description: Deterministic postcondition verification for AI agents and autonomous systems using independent observed state.

personal_repos.name: agentack
personal_repos.description: Local-first CLI for testing whether human approval and intervention controls in AI agent workflows actually work.

personal_repos.name: awesome-assured-autonomy
personal_repos.description: Curated research, tools, benchmarks, standards, and open-source systems for assuring autonomous systems.

personal_repos.name: latent-error-correcting-representations
personal_repos.description: Controlled PyTorch experiments testing whether error-correcting latent redundancy can detect and repair internal corruption, and where code-consistent drift evades it.

personal_repos.name: alignment-selective-metaplasticity
personal_repos.description: Controlled PyTorch experiments testing whether selective metaplasticity can preserve alignment-relevant behavior through sequential capability updates.

personal_repos.name: alignment-selection-dynamics

personal_repos.name: self-healing-embodied-agents
